summary.text: Critter Milton, a Unity Party candidate and former financial advisor who lives in Alma, Colorado, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. House seat in Colorado's 1st District to Melat Kiros.

paragraphs.text: Milton earned a degree from the University of Denver in 2006 and attended the College for Financial Planning for graduate study.

In his 2020 and 2022 Ballotpedia surveys he says he spent over a decade as a financial advisor and has done extensive backcountry exploration and volunteer work, and his 2022 survey gives his residence as Alma, Colorado.
He is a member of the organizing committee of Multiple Summits for Multiple Sclerosis.

Milton ran as the Unity Party candidate for Colorado's 3rd District in 2020, Colorado's 7th District in 2022, and this seat in 2024; Ballotpedia also lists him among withdrawn candidates for the 2020 Democratic U.S. Senate primary.
He received 0.4% of the vote to Melat Kiros's 78.3%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
